summary: Ellomay Capital furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that its wholly-owned Spanish subsidiary, Ellomay Solar S.L., received a battery storage grid access and connection permit for a 22.2 MW / 100.3 MWh (4.5-hour) BESS facility at its 28 MWp Talaván, Cáceres solar site, plus a 22.2 MW grid charging permit. This is an operational/development milestone, not a special situation. Construction is expected to begin early 2027 and complete in Q4 2027 on already-leased land; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors involved. Watch permitting and construction execution.
